items.markdown:
The best time to visit Krabi is from **November to March** . During these months, you’ll experience the ideal dry season with clear skies, lower humidity, and calm seas perfect for island hopping and snorkeling. Daytime temperatures average a pleasant 25°C to 32°C.[](https://www.tui.co.uk/holidays/weather/asia/thailand/thailand/krabi.html) [[1]](https://www.tui.co.uk/holidays/weather/asia/thailand/thailand/krabi.html)[[2]](https://www.thailandhighlights.com/thailand/krabi/best-time-to-visit)[[3]](https://pickyourtrail.com/tourism/thailand/best-time-to-visit-krabi)

For the absolute best combination of perfect weather and optimal underwater visibility, **February** is the top-rated month. Be aware that December to February is peak season, meaning beaches will be crowded and prices for Agoda hotels or flights will be at their highest.[](https://www.thailandhighlights.com/thailand/krabi/best-time-to-visit) [[1]](https://www.byklo.rent/en/blog/best-time-to-visit-krabi/)

If you prefer to dodge the crowds, consider the shoulder months of **April, May, and November** . April and May are the hottest months (climbing over 35°C), but they offer great Skyscanner flight deals before the heavy monsoon rains arrive.[](https://www.thailandhighlights.com/thailand/krabi/best-time-to-visit) [[1]](https://www.roughguides.com/thailand/itineraries/krabi-itinerary/)[[2]](https://www.firstchoice.co.uk/holidays/weather/asia/thailand/thailand/krabi.html)

The rainy season runs from **June to October** , with September and October historically seeing the heaviest rainfall and rough seas that can disrupt boat tours.[](https://www.thailandhighlights.com/thailand/krabi/best-time-to-visit) [[1]](https://www.excursionmania.com/article/when-to-avoid-visiting-krabi-blg-4615)
